colin: Heads-up - HelixCare asking for commit guidance. They want EU-only PHI, predictable monthly spend, and a small burst pool. Need quick reserve + autoscale rec.
deepa: Whats their traffic?
colin: Baseline 80 qps, 95th ~250 qps, daily spikes to ~900 qps for 10m. Mix of chat gen (~1.8k tokens) + embeddings.
sara: For that shape recommend reserving 3 A100-class GPUs (quantized) + 2 burst nodes. 3 reserved ~360 qps sustained with batching; bursts covered if preheated.
gavin: Preheat plan: schedule 30m KV warmup before expected spikes. If no window provided, reactive warmup will add early latency.
deepa: Pricing ask: can we include 12% monthly rollover burst credits?
sara: Yes for enterprise commits we can offer a small rollover (30d cap). Note: credits are region-bound for EU tenancy.
gavin: SLA note: offer p95 token latency SLA on reserved capacity (e.g., 250ms). Bursts only SLA-backed if preheated and part of committed capacity.
